children.title: Make charge-and-fling teach itself
children.what_to_build: Player grabs a cup, holds to charge, and releases to fling. A release before 0.35s drops the cup without launching, launch speed grows monotonically with hold time to about 14 m/s, and every charge is readable from a squash-stretch wind-up plus a code-drawn candy ring on the cup. All charge feedback is code/2D with zero new Blender meshes, and a full-charge throw must stay airborne at least 0.8s before landing or hitting something so flight reads as floaty-funny, never an air-pop or sink-through.

Charge wind-up (squash-stretch) and hold-time candy ring are code/2D only; zero new Blender meshes for this feedback (AC-7).

children.title: Make every fling outcome visible fast

No outcome is silent — a spill is a bounce plus a floor stain decal, both code-drawn. Hit and spill feedback stays code/2D with no new authored art.

children.title: Cover AFK stations with the bungling Shop Cat

children.title: Prove grief stays bounded and chaos stays honest
children.what_to_build: The chaos counter counts only consequential disruptions — stuns, spills, steals, sabotage, overdoses, expired orders, cat spills, machine stalls — each tagged with one of eight sources, while benign fling shots and successful serves never count. A 20-seed /sim sweep shows STEAL as the most-used deliberate verb (FLING excluded as the serve conveyor), no grief style exceeding half a shift's player-grief events, denial capped at 1.5 seconds per act, and the never-lose invariants holding: tips never drop below their stolen-away total, the rack always keeps at least 4 cups, and no machine stalls permanently. Ragging one target three times in 60 seconds triggers a public Big Vinny callout and culprit counter with zero mechanical penalty, and a recorded Play Mode demo shows all five verbs, the cat's bungles, and the shame line live.
acceptance: Chaos classifier: each of the 8 src tags assigned by the right event; benign fling shots / successful serves never increment ChaosEvents; median chaos ≥ 8/min over the 20-seed sweep with per-src breakdown printed (Refined Gate 1).

STEAL dominance: medians satisfy Steals > max(Chugs, Fixes, Sabotages) and Steals ≥ 6/shift; every bot steals ≥ 1x per shift under the opportunistic policy with no forced-event bot code (Refined Gate 2).
Grief balance: no player grief style > 50% share per seed or in aggregate; player grief events ≥ 6/shift median; src=cat and src=machine events excluded from the guard (Refined Gate 3).

Grief rails: denial ≤ 1.5s per event; 60s adversarial single-player griefing from any state cannot reduce any tip below its stolen-away total, destroy a cup (rack ≥ 4), stall all machines, or extend denial; solo griefer sinks the Quota in ≤ 20% of shifts; no removal mechanic exists (Refined Gate 5).

3+ grief acts by the same player on one target within 60s fires the Big Vinny public callout + public culprit counter with zero mechanical penalty; recorded in-editor Play Mode demo covers all five verbs + AFK-cat bungles + shame line; human-laugh evidence explicitly deferred to Artifact 8 and stated as such (Refined Gate 9).

children.title: Drive the one-block mule street

The rest of the shop keeps serving, and the whole interlude runs draft-to-back-in-shop in at most 45 seconds.

children.title: Enforce the look at build and import
children.what_to_build: The import-time validator grows teeth: it enforces the exact 15-name roster, per-mesh look fields (parent, rules, trace with a named rule for the ten gate entries, unique silhouette IDs for the five characters), the material-class whitelist of clay, plastic, and felt plus the specials, palette drift within one percent per channel, and the triangle cap — while a build-time audit script prints the mesh-by-rule traceability table and catches drift at authoring. Felt becomes an honest body material (the Shop Cat), and the CandyUI token contract — palette, corner radius, chunky borders, one bounce curve, big icons — is derived from the same palette json with the current HUD and awards screens flagged for Artifact 11's restyle. No idle animation may live outside BobbleController and GooglyEyes.
acceptance: Every mesh carries look.parent ∈ {clay, candy}, non-empty rules ⊆ {1..8}, a trace with ≥ 1 named rule for the 10 gate entries (5 characters + Cup, Tray, Sign, Espresso, Grinder), and a valid material-class prefix (Gate 2).
Palette lock: every manifest material within 0.01/channel of its palette key; CoreSceneBuilder.Validate rejects drift; material additions require a palette edit first (Gate 3).
Exactly 3 material classes + specials whitelist (clay_*, plastic_*, felt_* plus coffee/ink/sign_red); felt is a real body material (ShopCat), not apron trim (Gate 6).
Bobble-hint presence enforced by manifest scan on every living entity + every machine; runtime uses only BobbleController/GooglyEyes — zero idle anims outside them (Gate 5 enforcement).

CandyUI token contract (palette from the canonical json, corner radius ≥ 8% of element min side, chunky border ≥ 3px at 1080p, one shared bounce curve, huge icons) documented; existing HUD/awards screens flagged against tokens; restyle tracked to Artifact 11 (Gate 8).

children.title: Prove silhouettes differ and the wobble is one language
children.what_to_build: The renderer grows a silhouette-check module that produces two reproducible evidence sheets — a full-lit color contact sheet and a flat-black ink-silhouette sheet — and prints normalized pairwise IoU numbers so 'no two characters read as the same silhouette' is a re-runnable number, with thresholds locked after the first honest run and a false pass treated as a bug. Runtime idle life comes from exactly two components: BobbleController and GooglyEyes, which consume per-mesh rig hints procedurally — humans bobble, the cat's tail springs, machines vibrate, every googly puck squashes and follows — with deterministic seeded phase, zero-allocation delta sines on Transforms, and 60fps safety.
acceptance: 5 characters each have a unique silhouetteId; pairwise normalized IoU (ortho, ink-silhouette sheet) < 0.60 among characters, < 0.50 among the 4 machines, characters-vs-machines < 0.50 (Gate 4).

Sheets written to scratch as RATER evidence: full-lit color contact sheet + flat-black ink-silhouette sheet with printed pairwise IoU numbers; thresholds tune-and-lock on the first honest run, then fixed; a false pass is a bug.
Every living entity + every machine carries bobble hints; head diameter/height ≥ 0.35 on all humanoids; Vinny ≥ 1.25× Barista's head ratio (Gate 5).
Idle motion deterministic (seeded phase), zero-alloc, 60fps-safe; only BobbleController/GooglyEyes move the idle rigs — no hand-rolled idle anims anywhere (Gate 5 runtime).
